GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (15 Mar 46) LS
(SCAPIN-819)
APO 500
15 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 1 December 1945, file and subject as above, wherein the Imparial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one OKASAKI, Kumao, to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said OKASAKI's name. This name appears as the only name in paragraph 4, page Mo. 4 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. Fitch,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
